review: Final rendered visual inspection of changed-00.jpg through changed-29.jpg
method: Every contact image was opened with view_image and visually inspected. Five individual render PNGs were additionally opened, with page 241 checked again at original detail. This assessment is from rendered pages, not structural text or PDF-coordinate checks.
print_assessment: Body text, burgundy headings, paragraph frames and two-column questions are readable. No clipping, text spills, overlapping boxes, unintended continuation pages or displaced footers observed across these 120 pages. Lower whitespace on short speeches and endings preserves fixed stage gates and footer positions; it is not an accidental blank page. These sheets contain text and small museum/STOP icons rather than large artwork; icons are undistorted and stay within margins.

issues.description: Paige Turner introduction / packet page 3 has no STOP / wait-for-host panel. Brie DeVivre introduction / packet page 3 (page ID 373, changed-27.jpg) includes that panel. Paige’s text is complete and unclipped, but the introduction gate is inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: If page 3 is intended to stop players before the hearings, reserve space for a short STOP panel on Paige’s introduction. Shorten the repeated animal/key paragraph or tighten section spacing rather than shrinking body text. If no gate is required here, make the introduction-page convention consistent.
